newsitem.title: ITALY: Min rate falls to 6.77 pct at Italy lira repo.
newsitem.headline: Min rate falls to 6.77 pct at Italy lira repo.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 13.0 trillion lire 21-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 6.77 percent, compared with 6.78 percent at the previous repo tender on May 19, the Bank said.
The average rate was 6.81 percent against 6.83 percent at the last repurchase pact for 8.0 trillion lire and 28 days.
The pact covers purchases today and the securities are for resale on June 16. The Bank said it received 44 bids of which 31 were met in full and four in part.
